rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~6.7% on strong earnings and is trading at 91% of today's range near the session high after a significant move. With SPY down 1.52% and VIXY up 8.76% indicating broad market stress, chasing a long near the high carries substantial reversal risk, while shorting a strong earnings catalyst with momentum and relative strength also lacks a clear mechanical edge. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this extended price level with no clear consolidation or setup pattern to anchor a stop.
